Check an agent's label files against their evidence packets

Source: R/agent_labels.R
check_agent_labels.Rd

For every module in a workspace exported with export_agent_workspace(mode = 'label'), replays labels/<module_id>.json through synthesize_interpretation() via agent_label_backend(), runs check_faithfulness() against the module's packet, and checks the required review block against the ModuleSet itself:

  • every supporting hub is among the module's top 25 hubs, with the kME stated (within 0.01), and at least one is from the top 10;

  • at least 3 expected markers, each with the right status (in_module, in_network, unassigned, not_tested; the last two are told apart only when the workspace ships the input feature set);

  • the 3 display hubs are among the top 10 hubs, exclude housekeeping normalizers unless review$display_hub_overrides gives a reason, and do not repeat a gene family;

  • confidence$score lies in the band of review$confidence_level (high 0.75-0.95, moderate 0.5-0.75, low 0.25-0.5, very_low 0-0.25);

  • a technical artifact gate, a technical_artifact evidence tier and the possible_artifact flag go together;

  • a module meeting the artifact screen's dissociation-stress or depth-correlation threshold does not pass the gate, and one meeting the sample-concentration threshold is at most moderate and flagged label_low_specificity;

  • working notes exist at labels/notes/<module_id>.md, and every script in queries/<module_id>/ has its captured .out and is cited in them;

  • no two modules in the workspace share a proposed_label, unless one's review$related_module names the other.

Usage

check_agent_labels(workspace_dir, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

workspace_dir

Path to the exported workspace.

alpha

Significance threshold for the faithfulness wording check.

Value

A data.frame with one row per module (plus one per unexpected label file): module_id, status ('ok', 'missing', 'invalid', 'unfaithful', 'needs_revision' or 'unexpected'), proposed_label and detail.

Details

This is what the workspace's validate_labels.R runs, so an agent can iterate until every module is 'ok'.
